description: In every PA-model, the actual term test checks that term depth is nonzero and at most one plus the available slot depth.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.isTerm_value.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  (n e : M) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.isTerm.value ![n, e] =
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.truthValue
      (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.termDepth e ≠
          Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M ∧
        Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M
          (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.termDepth e)
          (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M n))
